company.notes: CIK verified in the EDGAR submissions JSON (name COCA COLA CO, ticker KO, exchange NYSE, state of incorporation DE). listed_since_year is a placeholder. No filing reviewed states the year the common stock was first listed on the NYSE. The earliest 10-K on EDGAR (FY1993, filed 1994-03-14) says the stock is listed and traded on the NYSE, and it reports a year-end market price for every year back to 1983. That establishes public trading well before 1990, so 1970 is used per convention. It is not the actual listing year. Evidence: e001-e004.

conflicts.description: Lagomasino's tenure has two stints. Every proxy gives 'Director since 2008', matching her 2008-10-16 election, but the 2025 proxy also lists 'Prior service as Director (2003 to 2006)'. Only the 2008-2026 stint is recorded; the earlier stint ended before 2020 and is out of scope.
Herb Allen's Grupo Televisa alternate-director seat is dated 'since 2003' in the 2024 proxy and 'since 2002' in the 2026 proxy. The bio entry keeps the 2026 wording and flags the difference.

Board-size bookkeeping has gaps. After Herbert A. Allen retired (2021-08-18), and again after the 2024-08-01 retirements, no filing states a reduction in the authorized size. The later 8-Ks say the board was 'increased' to 12 (2021-12-17, 2024-10-17). Seating Millhiser on 2023-07-01 and Levchin on 2025-10-16 came with no stated size change. Only disclosed changes are recorded as BOARD_SIZE_CHANGE events.

Millhiser was elected at the 2023-04-25 annual meeting, but her term began 2023-07-01. Her start date is 2023-07-01; proxies give 'Director since 2023'. The 2024 vote results spell her name 'Milhiser'.

Two different directors named Herbert A. Allen. Herbert A. Allen (CIK 0001131947, director since 1982) retired 2021-08-18. Herbert A. Allen III (CIK 0001295077), whom the company calls 'Herb Allen', was elected 2021-12-17. The 2022 proxy distinguishes 'Mr. Herbert A. Allen' from 'Mr. Herb Allen'. No filing reviewed states how they are related, so no relationship is recorded.

open_questions: Day Weinberg succeeded Lagomasino as Lead Independent Director in 2024: the proxies give only the year. The 2025 proxy pro-rates both directors' 2024 LID fees but states no handover date.

Committee assignments after the 2026 annual meeting: the 2026 proxy rosters are as of 2025-12-31, and Lagomasino's Talent and Compensation and Corporate Governance seats ended 2026-04-29. No 8-K discloses any reassignment, and Braun has no committee.
Current authorized board size is not stated. Twelve directors were elected on 2026-04-29 and none have left since.
Herbert A. Allen (1982) and Ronald W. Allen (1991) joined before EDGAR, so only the year is known.
Lagomasino's first stint (2003 to 2006) was not researched beyond the 2025 proxy line because it is out of scope.

Independence before 2013 was not reviewed. Spans for directors who joined earlier (R.W. Allen, Herbert A. Allen, Diller, Herman, Kotick, Lagomasino) start at 2013, the earliest determination reviewed.
Braun has no Form 4 as a director through 2026-09-28. His SEC CIK comes from his 2020 officer Form 3.
Listing year: no filing reviewed states when the common stock was first listed on the NYSE. 1970 is the placeholder for 'well before 1990' (see company.notes).

Other-board lists come from KO's own proxy bios as of each filing and are not checked against other issuers' filings. Fund boards Davis and Gayner list under 'Registered Companies (Investment Company Act of 1940)' are excluded.

coverage.method: Roster checked against the 2026 DEF 14A (filed 2026-03-16) and the 2026 Item 5.07 results (meeting 2026-04-29). Every 8-K filed after the DEF 14A was checked: the only Item 5.02 8-K (2026-06-25) is an officer change. Forms 3/4 through 2026-09-28 show no new director Form 3 and continued director Form 4s.

Every DEF 14A from 2019 to 2026 and every 8-K with Item 5.02, 5.03 or 5.07 filed 2018-2026 was reviewed, and the elected-director lists were compared across annual meetings. Departures are dated from 8-K effective dates or annual-meeting dates.

Start dates of directors who served on or after 2020-01-01 come from 8-K Item 5.02 filings (2006-2018), proxies (2002, 2013, 2017, 2018) and annual-meeting results. Departures before 2020 are not recorded.
